set.body:
Objective

Introduce a durable measurement_form with neural measurement axes, distinct from effect_form and scalar evidence.

Scope and deliverables

- Define complete and query-only measurement-form result contracts with ordered block indices and explicit edge completeness.
- Add memory and block-backed storage codecs without conflating codec with mathematical type or completeness.
- Record relation, experimental query, measurement-leg, frame, edge-set, partition, normalization-axis, transformation, reduction, regularization, and source identities in plans and receipts.
- Define construction-backed capabilities for self form, symmetry, guaranteed PSD, repeated-variation role, coherent joint covariance, and complete edge set.
- Record effective rank, eigenvalue bounds, condition numbers, and regularization effects only as tolerance-labelled diagnostics unless guaranteed by construction.
- Enforce reversal and typed-view eligibility.

Acceptance evidence

- Forged capabilities, swapped axes, incomplete stores, stale source revisions, and incompatible views fail before data reads where possible.
- Storage codecs round-trip every logical block and preserve semantic identity.
- Reversal transposes blocks and swaps measurement axes exactly.
- Existing effect_form and effect_view classes remain compatible and distinct.
- A measurement_form cannot be relabelled as an effect_form or upgraded from partial to complete.

Ownership boundary

Own result, storage, receipt, identity, and validation code. Raw contraction comes from Epic 4; scientific scalar views come later.

Deferred non-goals

No connectivity inference, CCA, information conversion, renderer, or public convenience constructor.
set.title: Epic 5: Add measurement-form results, storage, receipts, and capabilities
